The '''Bothan Sector Force''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]], assigned to the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was one of the most powerful Sector Force of the Rebellion. Like the [[Corellian Sector Force]], the Bothan Sector Force was known for remaining relatively independent of [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
